d:
Roshan hosts a Pani Puri party for all the women of Gokuldham society to celebrate Sodhi promising to take Tapu Sena out for a trip. The women praise Sodhi for being an obedient, caring husband and father, contrasting him with their own husbands who always make excuses to avoid going out.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
